models_evaluated: deep-learning-based auto-contouring model for prostate CTV and OARs

links.outcome: Geometric and dosimetric agreement of AI contours versus original and expert manual contours
links.effect: AC-vs-manual geometric differences were smaller than manual-vs-manual for bladder and femoral heads; IMRT PTV D95 77.62±0.38 Gy (AC) vs 77.58±0.69 (OC) and 77.71±0.53 (EC); contouring time 0.53 vs 24.9 min.
links.quote: Our automated contouring system can reduce inter-expert variability and achieve dosimetric accuracy comparable to gold standard reference contours, highlighting its potential for streamlining clinical workflows.

screen.reason: Evaluates the geometric and dosimetric impact and time savings of deep-learning auto-segmentation compared to manual contours by human experts in radiotherapy planning, but does not test a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
